description: A consistency mechanism that ensures multiple processor caches maintain a compatible view of shared memory when one cache reads or updates a value.
Automatic memory management that identifies objects a program can no longer reach and reclaims their storage without requiring explicit deallocation by the programmer.
A control mechanism that restricts how many requests an actor may make during a time interval in order to protect capacity and preserve service availability.
A database property that controls how concurrent transactions can observe one another's intermediate changes so that interference does not produce invalid results.
The regulation of internal conditions around a viable range through sensing, feedback, and corrective responses despite changes in the external environment.
The net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane toward the side with greater effective solute concentration until the driving imbalance is reduced.
The value of the best alternative that is forgone when limited resources are committed to one choice rather than another.
Ongoing assessment during learning that gathers evidence of understanding and uses timely feedback to adjust teaching and help learners improve before final evaluation.
